synthetic_data_notice: This experiment ran on the local synthetic demonstration dataset (50,000 tokens). The authoritative competition results are from the real 411,137-deployment archive in experiment_manifest.json.
decision: v1.1.0 RETAINED — v1.2 did not improve on synthetic test set. The frozen 5-feature model remains the competition submission.
interpretation: The fact that past_launches and deployer_age_seconds remain in the top-4 even on synthetic data independently corroborates the real model's SHAP finding that these are the dominant behavioral signals.
